boundary.label: What it takes from you, and the limits on that
boundary.quote_limits: A processor shall not sell industrial hemp or a substance containing an industrial hemp extract, as defined in § 3.2-5145.1 , to a person if the processor knows or has reason to know that such person will use the industrial hemp or substance containing an industrial hemp extract

plain-words.label: Can an ordinary reader follow it
